summary_en: This note studies the limit of a parameter-dependent sum \(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{n+f(k)}\) with \(f(k)=\frac{2k(k-1)}{2k-1}\). It compares termwise Taylor expansion and integral estimation, then solves the problem by comparing the sum to \(\sum_{k=1}^n \frac{1}{n+k}\) and proving the difference is \(o(1)\), yielding the limit \(\log 2\).

problems.statement_en: Find the limit of the parameter-dependent sum \(\sum_{k=1}^{n}\frac{1}{n+f(k)}\), where \(f(k):=\frac{2k(k-1)}{2k-1}\).

key_techniques_discussed: asymptotic comparison with a known sum
connections_mentioned: asymptotic expansion from known asymptotic results
